[EN] I believe the plague hasn't spread to Frontera because they use a different well.

In order to confirm my hypothesis, however, I need you to go to the Quarantined Village and collect samples of their contaminated wellwater.

Leave them with {@LinkCreature:240#1035$$Narpa}.
[ES] Creo que la plaga no se ha extendido a Frontera porque usan un pozo diferente.

Sin embargo, para confirmar mi hipótesis, necesito que vayas al Quarantined Village y recojas muestras del agua contaminada de su pozo.

Déjaselas a {@LinkCreature:240#1035$$Narpa}.

[EN] Excellent! Now I can continue with my research. With luck, we'll find a way to end this.
[ES] ¡Excelente! Ahora puedo continuar con mi investigación. Con suerte, encontraremos la manera de acabar con esto.

[EN] We must have samples of the contaminated wellwater from the village! Please—we're counting on you.
[ES] ¡Debemos tener muestras del agua de pozo contaminada de la aldea! Por favor, contamos contigo.
